summary: Candidate E v1 is rejected. Its independent-input strategy protects the detailed map and north-east meets the raw range, but south-east is too weak for safe normalization and repeated cloudy masses remain. No final candidate artifact was published.
required_changes: Change only the south-east source-plate amplitude around its median to roughly twice E v1; preserve north-east, shapes, scale, transitions, control thresholds, and final transfer behavior.
